valuation.method: Forward EPS x P/E (FY2027E EPS viewed at the 12-month target date), cross-checked against net cash of $3,416M ($3,613M cash less $197M debt as of Q3 2026)

bear.driver: Gold price pullback and persistent consumables/diesel cost inflation compressing margins

base.driver: Sustained elevated gold prices (~$4,000-$4,250/oz), steady Detour Lake/Fosterville/Kittila output, and disciplined AISC (~$1,650/oz)

bull.driver: Higher realized gold prices, Odyssey/pipeline execution, and operating leverage on flat unit costs

valuation.implied_by_close: At base FY2027E EPS of $12.00, the $178.45 close implies 14.9x P/E; the ~$227 equal-weight named-analyst target implies 18.9x P/E or $12.61 EPS at 18.0x.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $12.00 (6.7 pp of return at the $178.45 close).
valuation.watch_metric: Quarterly payable gold production (oz) and all-in sustaining costs (AISC $/oz) relative to full-year guidance, alongside realized gold price.

analyst_notes: Following Q3 2026 results on October 28, 2026 (adjusted EPS $2.62, 814,012 oz gold, $1,648/oz AISC), named analysts largely maintained constructive ratings with minor target fine-tuning: Barclays trimmed to $215, CIBC trimmed to $237, and JPMorgan nudged up to $193 (Neutral). The ~$227 equal-weight named-analyst target sits ~6.2 pp above the $216.00 base case (+27.3% vs +21.0% upside), reflecting higher assumed multiples (18.9x vs 18.0x) or slightly higher gold-price/EPS assumptions. Target horizons were not explicitly documented in the secondary summaries, so horizon_months is left null.
